title: Ganpati Sthapana Ceremony
description: Ganpati idol will be installed at the society mandap on 12th September at 10:00 AM. All residents are requested to attend with their families. Prasad distribution after the ceremony.

title: Evening Maha Aarti — Daily
description: Daily Maha Aarti will be performed at 7:00 PM at the society mandap. All residents are welcome to participate. Special aarti arrangements on Fridays.

title: Cultural Program Registration Open
description: Registration is now open for the cultural evening on 18th September. Interested participants can register with the Cultural Coordinator. Categories: Dance, Song, Drama, Comedy, Instrument.

title: Children's Drawing Competition
description: Drawing competition for children aged 4-14 years on 15th September at 4:00 PM. All art materials will be provided. Prizes for all participants!

title: Visarjan Schedule Announced
description: Ganpati Visarjan will be on 22nd September (Anant Chaturdashi). The procession starts at 4:00 PM from the society mandap. Details about dhol-tasha, flower decoration and route will be shared soon.

title: Contribution Collection Update
description: Thank you to all residents who have contributed to the Ganpati fund. Collection is still open. Please contact the Treasurer for payment details.

title: Rangoli Competition
description: Rangoli competition on 17th September at 10:00 AM in the society compound. Teams of 2-3 members. Theme: Ganpati & Nature. Materials provided.

title: Prasad Sponsorship
description: Residents interested in sponsoring evening prasad on any day during the festival can contact the Event Coordinator. First come first served.
